description: This file defines the JavaFieldsConsumer class, which implements ConfigurationConsumer. It processes configuration data, writes Java field definitions to an internal buffer, and upon completion, generates a 'Fields.java' class file containing these definitions and constants.

classes.name: JavaFieldsConsumer
classes.description: A consumer class that generates Java fields class from configuration data, writing output during the file end process.

methods.name: writeFields
methods.description: Static helper method that writes the accumulated Java field definitions and related constants into the 'Fields.java' file.

methods.name: JavaFieldsConsumer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the consumer with writers, state, and output path.

methods.name: startFile
methods.description: Method called at the start of processing a file; implementation is empty.

methods.name: endFile
methods.description: Method called at the end of processing a file; triggers writing of the accumulated Java fields to output.

methods.name: handleEndStruct
methods.description: Handles the end of a structure; writes Java fields when appropriate.
